state.goal: Resolve original CanMember page guard and CanShift Coverage.met bool derived-field membership reads without altering authored guards, eligibility, lazy order, read permissions or revocation. Smallest complete finite implementation, no audit or general effect system.

verified_mechanisms: active_member is a checked StateRead builtin, current supplied-user/verified-team membership, not a read grant. Membership-reading DeriveFn is admitted for bounded current decision/read sites; strict pure contexts transitively refuse it. Page Require currently adds entire predicate to strict_purity_roots; DeriveField unconditionally strict pure. This produces exactly two of three original CRM24source diagnostics.

Compiler prepares exact original source/call/argument slot/default/derive-chain membership recipes against fresh source+IR; markers/public metadata alone never authorize. Native runtime active_member requires a private installed frame and actual State call/read observation with exact live user/Team captured; no global fallback is allowed.

Existing State installed source boolean predicate path supports read-policy/read-predicate stages, binds exact installed callable and complete checked sites before execution, then observes current membership. createSourceReadPolicyAdapter builds permission-aware native navigation, runs predicate once in a fresh read frame, preserves lazy evaluation, revalidates navigation and membership alongside State revision/lifetime fencing. This path does not grant stored rows through membership alone.

Current page descriptor.admit(c,routeBindings) directly evaluates guard; HTTP calls it without State observation. Current derived emitter is async(c,row), callable kind Pure; nativeProjectedRecord exposes stored fields/metadata/navigation only and does not evaluate derived fields. Merely allowing typing would leave both native contexts unsupported.

An internal compiler-owned boolean predicate wrapper for each original page guard/derived bool could reuse actual existing State source read observation. Must retain exact original callable/source and complete dependency census, actual owning subject/revision, current read/field policy, lazy order, invocation-lifetime closure and revalidation. Native loader grants no metadata authority. Bool met is finite; generic nonbool membership-derived values, defaults, captions, invariants and retention remain outside this fix.
state.acceptance: Original Member guard denies nonmanager/nonadministrator, accepts correct current manager/work-location or administrator branch, preserves short circuit and field policies, refuses after revocation/change. Original Coverage.met bool preserves coverage calculation/current eligible employee membership; read field remains withheld without owning read authority, no stale value/replay/foreign source bypass. Original CRM composition compiles; targeted native integration exercises both consumers and negative controls.
state.alternatives: All options below must satisfy same original-source/native/current-authority and no-cached-grant outcomes. A typing-only relaxation, dropping source guard/derive or replacing current membership with stored snapshot is incomplete and not an option.
